verdict.rationale: The README claims Solid has "full SSR and serverless support" with streaming and progressive hydration, and that components render isomorphically on client and server. That supports the core of serverless SSR, but only as a single high-level claim with no detail on how deployment works. missing for 10: evidence of edge-runtime support, deployment adapters or presets that avoid custom infrastructure setup, deployment documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of serverless or edge deploys.
